concepts.name: Neapolitan crown A
concepts.prompt:
Edit the supplied Giulietto profile king logo into one refined variation.
Image 1 is the king identity/layout reference. Images 2–5 are the ACTUAL NEAPOLITAN PLAYING CARDS and are authoritative suit-shape references. Replace the generic symbols completely using the shapes from those cards.
Image 2 BASTONI: use ONE of these distinctive wide elongated rounded batons with a tapered bent handle and a central feather-like leafy motif, not a baseball bat, twig or clover.
Image 3 SPADE: use ONE long straight narrow blade with the ornate double-scroll circular crossguard, wrapped grip and curled pommel from this card, not a short generic dagger.
Image 4 COPPE: use ONE broad bulbous scalloped chalice with flared oval rim, two slender curled handles, short ornamental stem and rectangular foot, matching this card rather than a trophy.
Image 5 DENARI: use ONE round coin with the central HUMAN SUN FACE and surrounding petal-like sun rays plus outer rings, matching this card rather than an empty disc.
Simplify fine hatching only; preserve these identifying shapes and ornament. Render the suits in the king's berry #9b285a and cream #fbf8fa palette, with enough internal contrast to recognize the details.
Layout: Four broad crown points, each containing one cream suit emblem. Exactly one of each suit, in cup/sword/baton/coin order when in a row.
Preserve the right-facing profile king's eye, nose outline, moustache, hair and collar. One single finished square logo on plain cream background. Flat crisp graphic artwork, balanced spacing, generous margins, no text, no mockups, no gradients.
